interface.shortDescription: Olli and the Loop sales plays, on your live deals
interface.longDescription: A full toolbox of enterprise sales plays: multithreading, account planning, call prep and follow-up, champion enablement, competitive displacement, deal advancement, QBR prep, managing up, and the one-page business case. Each pulls your live deal context (from Loop, Fluint's MCP), writes in the buyer's own language, applies a named framework, and ends in a forwardable deliverable. Start with the router if you are not sure which play you need.
